name: dez-commercial
description: Product-style commercial for Dez Aguila's portfolio, built with Remotion

scripts.render: remotion render DezCommercial out/dez-commercial-raw.mp4 --crf=20 && npm run finish
scripts.finish: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/dez-commercial-raw.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 22 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -color_range tv -movflags +faststart -an ../docs/media/dez-commercial.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/dez-commercial-raw.mp4 -c:v libvpx-vp9 -b:v 0 -crf 36 -row-mt 1 -deadline good -cpu-used 2 -pix_fmt yuv420p -an ../docs/media/dez-commercial.webm
